starting-out.speaker: Brother Kojo
starting-out.text: Hello adventurer. My name is Brother Kojo. Do you happen to know the time?

starting-out.speaker: Brother Kojo
starting-out.text: Exactly! This clock tower has recently broken down, and without it nobody can tell the correct time. I must fix it before the town people become too angry!

starting-out.speaker: Brother Kojo
starting-out.text: I don't suppose you could assist me in the repairs? I'll pay you for your help.

steps.player: OK old monk, what can I do?

steps.speaker: Brother Kojo
steps.text: Oh, thank you kindly! In the cellar below, you'll find four cogs. They're too heavy for me, but you should be able to carry them one at a time.

steps.speaker: Brother Kojo
steps.text: I know one goes on each floor... but I can't exactly remember which goes where specifically. Oh well, I'm sure you can figure it out fairly easily.

steps.speaker: Brother Kojo
steps.text: Thank you again! And remember to be careful, the cellar is full of strange beasts!

steps.speaker: Brother Kojo
steps.text: OK then. Come back and let me know if you change your mind.

starting-out-talking-to-brother-kojo-aga.speaker: Brother Kojo
starting-out-talking-to-brother-kojo-aga.text: Oh hello, are you having trouble? The cogs are in four rooms below us. Place one cog on a pole on each of the four tower levels.

starting-out-talking-to-brother-kojo-aga.player: Right, gotcha. I'll do that then.

black-cog.text: If the player does not have a bucket of water or ice gloves equipped:

steps.text: The cog is red hot from the flames. You cannot pick it up.

black-cog.text: If the player has a bucket of water or ice gloves equipped:

steps.text: You pour water over the cog. It quickly cools down enough to take.

white-cog.text: Trying to open the door before the rats have been poisoned:

steps.text: This door does not seem to be openable.

white-cog.text: Using the poison on the food trough:

steps.text: The rats swarm towards the poisoned food...
You see them smashing against the gates in a panic.

white-cog.text: Opening the door after poisoning the rats:

steps.text: The death throes of the rats seem to have shaken the door loose its hinges. You pick it up and go through.

placing-the-cogs-after-placing-a-cog.speaker: Brother Kojo
placing-the-cogs-after-placing-a-cog.text: That's great. Come see me when you've done the other three.

finishing-up.player: I have replaced all the cogs!

finishing-up.speaker: Brother Kojo
finishing-up.text: Really..? Wait, listen! Well done, well done! Yes yes yes, you've done it! You ARE clever!

finishing-up.speaker: Brother Kojo
finishing-up.text: The townsfolk will all be able to know the correct time now! Thank you so much for all of your help! And as promised, here is your reward!
